title: Draw and dose liquid with a syringe (two Frankas, operational-space control)
text: Fill the syringe from the beaker, put about a third of a syringe into each of the three test tubes, then lay the syringe back down where it was on the shelf.
success: Success: the syringe was filled nearly full from the beaker; each of the three tubes got between about a quarter and two fifths of a full syringe; and the syringe now lies back at its starting spot on the shelf, roughly flat and at rest.
